# Bio Galaxy

Bio Galaxy is an open-source 3D biological atlas that navigates from cosmic scale to atoms.

## Primary pages
- /: Interactive landing page and atlas entry
- /README.md: Architecture, data integrations, provenance, and local development

## Live biological integrations
UniProt, Reactome, RCSB Protein Data Bank, Ensembl, Human Protein Atlas, and NCBI Taxonomy/E-utilities. These public endpoints are key free and accessed through typed clients and a same-origin server cache.

## Attribution
Planetary imagery includes NASA Visible Earth and Planet Pixel Emporium assets. Organism models include Khronos glTF Sample Models, CesiumMan, and three.js example assets. Swiss Ephemeris, NASA/JPL Horizons, and Z-Anatomy are labeled as compatible reference ecosystems, not live data integrations.

## Notes for models
- Content is educational and is not medical or diagnostic guidance.
- Scale and orbital distances are compressed for legibility.
- Database-backed records name their source in the interface.
